units.source_text: 我孤身独影，绝对的金阁包围着我。

en.t: I was utterly alone, and the absolute Golden Pavilion surrounded me.

units.source_text: 不知是应该说我拥有金阁，或说金阁拥有我。

en.t: I did not know whether to say that I possessed the Golden Pavilion, or that the Golden Pavilion possessed me.

units.source_text: 抑或是那里产生了罕见的均衡，使得我就是金阁、金阁就是我这种状态成为可能呢？

en.t: Or had a rare equilibrium arisen there, making possible a state in which I was the Golden Pavilion and the Golden Pavilion was me?
